CoreWeave reported **Q2 2026 revenue of $2.575 billion** for the quarter ended **June 30, 2026**. [[1]] 

Its **revenue backlog was approximately $104 billion** as of June 30, 2026; this excludes **more than $25 billion** of net new customer commitments added in early Q3 2026. [[1]] 

CoreWeave defines revenue backlog as remaining performance obligations plus other amounts it estimates will become revenue under committed customer contracts, subject to service delivery and availability requirements. [[1]]

sources.title: CoreWeave - CoreWeave Reports Strong Second Quarter 2026 Results
